response.title: Risk Management & Disaster Preparedness
response.sheltersDesc: Designated emergency relief camps, district hospitals, and primary evacuation corridors mapped per district disaster management plans.
response.before1: Identify safe high-ground evacuation areas away from steep slopes and natural drainages.
response.before2: Prepare an emergency Go-Bag with first aid, essential medications, flashlights, and vital documents.
response.before3: Monitor regional IMD weather bulletins and NER Landslide Guard alerts during monsoon seasons.
response.before4: Inspect property slopes for new tension cracks, tilting trees, fence leaning, or muddy seepage.
response.during1: Quickly move perpendicular (sideways) out of the path of debris flow, never downhill in line with the slide.
response.during2: Stay far clear of swollen mountain streams, gullies, and culverts susceptible to sudden mudflow surges.
response.during3: Strictly heed official local evacuation warnings and follow designated safe corridors.
response.during4: Dial 112 or NDMA 1078 to report trapped persons or blocked emergency routes immediately.
response.after1: Stay away from the slide area; secondary collapses and progressive failures frequently occur.
response.after2: Check for trapped or injured neighbors without entering hazardous unstable slip zones.
response.after3: Inspect utility lines (power, gas, water); report downed electrical wires to emergency crews.
response.after4: Do not enter damaged dwellings until structural engineers or district disaster authorities certify them safe.

about.title: About NER Landslide Guard
about.overviewText: NER Landslide Guard is a specialized geotechnical and meteorological intelligence platform designed to protect communities, highways, and infrastructure across the eight mountainous states of North Eastern India through proactive AI hazard forecasting and real-time early warnings.
about.problemText: The North Eastern Region of India accounts for over 50% of the country's total landslide-prone landmass. Steep terrain, intense seasonal monsoon rainfall, high seismic activity, and fragile soil geology lead to recurrent blockages of critical national highways, isolation of communities, and tragic loss of lives and livelihood.
about.mlText: Combines a scikit-learn Random Forest model trained on multi-parameter environmental signatures with a standardized geotechnical formula (0.35 rainfall + 0.25 soil moisture + 0.20 slope + 0.10 vibration + 0.10 tilt) to provide dual-perspective risk evaluation.
about.iotText: Microcontroller nodes (ESP32 / Arduino) deploy solar-powered sensor arrays communicating via secure HTTP REST APIs and MQTT message brokers with automatic offline/degraded watchdog monitoring.
about.dbText: SQLAlchemy ORM with local SQLite support and high-performance production PostgreSQL with geospatial indexing capability.
about.dataStatusText: Current telemetry readings, incident records, and predictions are simulated for demonstration purposes. Official disaster advisories must only be issued based on verified Geological Survey of India (GSI) and National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) protocols.
